_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S5 Joovy). Sourced 2026-07-05. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Joovy Balloon

clekListed.clekRow: Joovy Balloon — Universal Car Seat Adapter

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (multi-position near-flat/bassinet recline; also usable from newborn with a car seat)

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833 (mandatory for US strollers); Clek confirms all listed strollers were tested to the applicable ASTM standards for car seats on strollers.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible handlebar; 4-wheel suspension; bumper bar. Joovy does not publish a per-model JPMA certification for this model.

specs.recline: multi-position reclining backrest to near-flat (bassinet mode)
specs.tires: 4-wheel, foam/EVA tires; swivel front wheels with suspension

notes: Discontinued at Joovy's DTC store (not in the current joovy.com catalog); circulates on the used/resale market (GoodBuy Gear ~$95 for a 2018 unit, out of stock at check). Original MSRP was ~$199. Light (12.7 lb) full-feature single with a near-flat bassinet-mode recline — one of the lighter city/shopping options in this batch, though heavier and less compact-folding than a BabyZen YOYO. Clek Liing attaches via the Joovy Universal Car Seat Adapter (adapter-joovy-universal). No reliable current retail price found; Amazon price left null rather than guessed.
